mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase betamethasone metabolism through competitive inhibition, while betamethasone can induce hepatic enzymes affecting gemfibrozil efficacy; both drugs increase hyperglycemia and immunosuppression risk.
action: Monitor glucose control and lipid panel closely; adjust betamethasone dose if needed and consider alternative fibrate; counsel on infection signs and hyperglycemia symptoms.
